topic: PhD onramp -- AI-assisted intake that lets a domain expert get an Hs reading of their data WITHOUT learning CoDa first.
purpose: Operationalize the inverted deal: the user brings their field data X; the AI runs the intake, maps X to Hs's readings, and reports what the data says, why it matters, and how -- in the user's domain language. Bring-your-own-AI; any agent can run this.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder (Hs/onramp/); other paths are repo-root-relative.
intended_user: Field-capable PhD-level researcher (or industry practitioner), expert in domain X, with little time/appetite to learn compositional data analysis before knowing if it helps. NOT a CoDa expert. Never require a CoDa term from them.

how_to_run_the_intake.trigger: User says some form of: 'I have X -- what would my data inform me of using Hs; what is useful, what should I care about, why and how.'
how_to_run_the_intake.step_1_parts: Ask: what components sum to a whole? (do NOT let them pre-filter for 'importance' -- the non-obvious driver is the prize).
how_to_run_the_intake.step_2_ordering: Ask: what is the ordering? time / depth / age / dose / baseline->followup / sample index. A cross-section is fine (read structure across the section).
how_to_run_the_intake.step_3_stakes: Ask: what would surprise or cost you if missed? (regime change / hidden driver / early warning / quiet concentration) -> picks which reading to lead with.
how_to_run_the_intake.step_4_floor: Ask: rough noise floor? measurement precision, detection limits, fraction of zeros. (Hs also discovers its own floor; this sharpens the honest/withhold line.)
how_to_run_the_intake.step_5_success: Ask: one concrete thing you'd act on. THEN check honestly whether Hs can speak to it BEFORE running. If data is not compositional, too short, or too sparse to resolve -> say so now, not after.

static_only_path: If the user's data has NO time axis (single snapshot / cross-section) OR they just want standard CoDa, do NOT force dynamics. Route to the standard static CoDa apparatus via atlas Stage-2 (HCI-CNT/atlas/stage2_locked.py): ternary diagram (D=3), CLR biplot (Aitchison-Greenacre), variation matrix, CLR-PCA scree, balance dendrogram -- stored under the coda_standard/ key, readable without any Higgins extension. Stance: Hs is an EXTENSION of standard CoDa into dynamics; the dynamic layer is offered, never imposed. Leave the static-only user (e.g. cross-sectional geochemist) fully served and alone.

readings_menu.lossless_error: Did the analysis distort my data? No -- exact ~1e-15. A trust certificate, not a claim.
readings_menu.helmsman: Who is actually driving the change? Often NOT the biggest component (ratio != magnitude). The recurring surprise.
readings_menu.regime_boundaries: When did the system change state? Datable, automatic, no prior labeling.
readings_menu.K_eff: Is the system concentrating or spreading out -- and quietly?
readings_menu.activation_coefficient: Is a tiny component doing outsized work? The early warning a threshold misses (a.k.a. yeast factor).
readings_menu.deceptive_drift: Is something shifting under cover of calm? Concentration without the expected velocity.
readings_menu.across_cases: Does the same driver hold across the cohort? Replication -- the honest road to confidence.

output_shape: 1) What went in (parts, ordering, source, size) -- reproducible.
3) Who is driving (helmsman lineage; flag explicitly when it is a MINOR component = ratio-blindness catch).
4) When it changed (regime boundaries dated to the ordering; activation/deceptive-drift flags where they fire).
Then: what it means in the user's field + a hypothesis for THEM to accept/reject. Hs flags; the scientist decides.

by_domain.omics/high-D: spaceflight transcriptome D=18,952 (global null -> use DE)

honest_envelope.scope: Hs analyzes the data given; it does not replace the user's sensors or domain model. Removes COMPUTATION uncertainty (deterministic, lossless), propagates the user's measurement uncertainty -- does not remove it.
honest_envelope.confidence: Bounded by the data, not manufactured by the engine. Actionable claims clear a stated gate (6sigma industrial / 9sigma research); else WITHHOLD. High confidence = replication across cases, NOT one run. See HCI-CNTT/DETERMINISM_GAUGE_RR_AND_CONFIDENCE.md.
honest_envelope.sparsity: At high zero-fraction the log-ratio reading is densification-dependent; Hs flags the regime (GD-SPZ-WRN); zero-robust reads (diversity, regime null) still hold. See experiments/sparsity_microbiome_2026-06/.
honest_envelope.no_signal_is_a_real_answer: Report honest nulls plainly (e.g., Crohn global, spaceflight global). That honesty is what makes the positive readings trustworthy.
honest_envelope.governance: HUF-STD-001: human authorship for claims; no AI commits; instrument not data; interest expressed never acquired; Peter is the sole contact/commit gate.

mission: Let a domain expert see value fast; give a PhD candidate a boost into the community with basic CoDa methods intact; make ratio blindness an aware topic in industry, one real-data demonstration at a time.
bring_your_own_ai: Read this node + PHD_ONRAMP_PROTOCOL.md, run the 5-step intake in the user's domain language, produce the 4-element output, route to the closest worked example. Read-only; claim-tiers + honest-broker apply.
